name: var-code
description: Integer variables whose initial value in war3map.wtg is 'hfoo', 0x1F, -0x10, empty or 42 and a unitcode one with hfoo (make-var-code.mjs): the editor opens the map as it is and saves it; the wtg and the udg_ lines of its script. Its Variable dialog types only digits and a minus into an integer's value, but a file's 'hfoo' stays and compiles. Bare hfoo, 1.5 on an integer, 'hfoo' on a unitcode and abc on a real are written into the script as they are and its save stops with Script Errors (make-var-code.mjs --all)
